name: io.github.qmmughal/titan-email-mcp
description: MCP server for Titan Email (IMAP/SMTP), tested and confirmed with GoDaddy mailboxes.

environmentVariables.description: Your Titan Email mailbox address, e.g. you@yourdomain.com
environmentVariables.name: TITAN_EMAIL

environmentVariables.description: Your Titan Email password (use an app-specific password if your provider offers one)
environmentVariables.name: TITAN_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: IMAP/SMTP host preset: "titan" (default) for native Titan Email, or "godaddy" if your domain and mailbox were purchased through GoDaddy
environmentVariables.name: TITAN_PROVIDER

environmentVariables.description: Display name shown on outgoing mail
environmentVariables.name: TITAN_FROM_NAME

environmentVariables.description: Set to "false" to disable send_email and sending replies (read + draft-only mode)
environmentVariables.name: TITAN_ALLOW_SEND

environmentVariables.description: Folder name sent-mail copies are appended to
environmentVariables.name: TITAN_SENT_FOLDER

environmentVariables.description: Folder name drafts are saved to
environmentVariables.name: TITAN_DRAFTS_FOLDER
